statements.quote: Chemically identical generic versions manufactured in India sell for as low as $0.30 to $3.00 per pill.

source.title: Revlimid (lenalidomide): US price versus India (Google AI Overview)

statements.price: US brand Revlimid: $900 to $1,000 per pill. Indian generic: $0.30 to $3.00 per pill.
statements.availability: Some American patients order through Canadian pharmacies that route orders to Indian manufacturers.
statements.approval: The US FDA approves generic lenalidomide and many Indian plants; patents and market exclusivity, not chemistry, keep the generic out of the US.
